title: Hajj and Umrah Pilgrim Capacity Expansion (زيادة الطاقة الاستيعابية لضيوف الرحمن)
description: Increasing the annual pilgrim capacity to 30 million by 2030 while maintaining high standards of health, logistics, safety, and smooth crowd movements.
entity: Ministry of Hajj and Umrah (وزارة الحج والعمرة)

title: Water Scarcity and Desalination Energy Reduction (مواجهة شح المياه وتقليل تكلفة التحلية)
description: Saudi Arabia relies heavily on desalination, which consumes massive amounts of energy. Challenges include increasing efficiency and transitioning to clean energy.
entity: Saline Water Conversion Corporation (المؤسسة العامة لتحلية المياه المالحة)

title: Heat mitigation in holy sites and urban cities (تخفيف درجات الحرارة في المشاعر المقدسة والمدن)
description: Extreme summer temperatures in Makkah, Mina, and Arafat threaten pilgrim safety. Seeking innovative coatings, green infrastructure, and cooling systems.

title: AI-powered Disease Prevention and Diagnostics (الوقاية والتشخيص المبكر القائم على الذكاء الاصطناعي)
description: Implementing preventive health screenings, tracking infectious diseases during pilgrimage seasons, and integrating genetic research into therapy.

title: Waste Management and Circular Economy (إدارة النفايات والاقتصاد الدائري في المشاعر المقدسة)
description: Mina and Arafat generate massive organic and plastic waste within short periods. Solving waste accumulation, sorting, and processing locally.
entity: National Center for Waste Management (المركز الوطني لإدارة النفايات - موان)

title: Sovereign Arabic Language Technology (توطين تقنيات اللغة العربية والذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي)
description: Developing local Arabic NLP systems, legal contract analysis, and customer service bots that understand Arabic dialects, culture, and Islamic concepts.
entity: Saudi Data and AI Authority (سدايا - SDAIA)

title: Autonomous and Smart Transportation (النقل المستقل والذكي لتسهيل التفويج)
description: Developing self-driving buses, drone-based route planning, and smart parking algorithms to manage traffic entering Makkah and moving between holy sites.
entity: Ministry of Transport (وزارة النقل والخدمات اللوجستية)
